login_page_design.layout: Two-column split layout or immersive hero frame based on login (2).jpg reference
login_page_design.interactive_barong: Interactive 3D-feeling Barong image component with mouse movement tracking (parallax tilt/rotate effect on mousemove)
login_page_design.captcha_integration: Dynamic Math / Visual Captcha verification before sign in submission
login_page_design.role_selector_and_credentials: Quick demo login switcher buttons for test roles (Admin, Admin Project, Developer, Accounting, Client)
login_page_design.styling: Matching dark blue dashboard aesthetic, glow borders, glassmorphic card container

footer_requirements.styling: Persistent dashboard footer, muted text with blue accent link on hover, centered or bottom right aligned

Admin.access: Full System Access (User Management, Financials, All Projects, System Audit, Settings, Ticket Escalation)

Admin Project.access: Project Lifecycle Management, Workflow Assignment, Milestones, Client Approval, Revisions, Tickets

Developer.access: Assigned Projects Only, Task Status, Technical Documents, Code/Deployment Repos, Revisions (In-Scope)

Accounting.access: Financial Overview, Invoices, Payment Status, Project Budget vs Actual Cost, Client Invoicing

Client.access: Client Portal, Project Progress Tracker, Document Download, Revision Submissions, Client Ticket Management

image_urls.description: Indonesian Female Executive / Project Manager Avatar

instructions_to_main_agent.language: Bahasa Indonesia (All labels, menus, tooltips, status badges, notifications must be in polite Indonesian business tone)
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testids: All buttons, inputs, tabs, selects, table rows, and links MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="login-submit-btn", data-testid="project-status-select")
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Use Framer Motion or CSS transitions for mouse parallax on Barong, soft tab transitions, KPI hover lifts, glowing blue borders
instructions_to_main_agent.security_rule: Never show internal project cost, profit margin, developer rate, or internal notes to Client role.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid default Vercel white/black templates; strictly apply the rich deep navy & vibrant blue design system
Use 2-3x generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) for card containers to prevent collisions
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, popovers, or sticky headers (always use backdrop-blur with bg-slate-900/90 or similar)
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes for testing
Use sonner for user feedback toasts (toast.success, toast.error)
